cards.statement: Hand luggage is the suitcase that goes in the plane's hold.
cards.explanation: Hand luggage viaja contigo en la cabina; el equipaje de bodega no es hand luggage.

cards.statement: A trip focuses only on the exact road between two stations.
cards.explanation: Journey pone el foco en el trayecto; trip incluye la visita o experiencia.

cards.statement: A train leaves from a gate.
cards.explanation: Los trenes salen de un platform; los aviones salen de un gate.

cards.statement: A connection is a second transport that continues your trip.
cards.explanation: Connection es el enlace con otro tren, vuelo o transporte.

cards.statement: Passengers wait on a platform for a train.
cards.explanation: Platform es el andén del tren.

cards.statement: We travelled by train to York.
cards.explanation: By train indica el medio de transporte.

cards.statement: A platform is normally used for a bus at the airport gate.
cards.explanation: Platform es principalmente el andén del tren; gate es la puerta del avión.

cards.statement: After an international flight, passengers may go through customs.
cards.explanation: Customs es el control de aduanas.

cards.statement: A connecting flight is always a flight with no stops.
cards.explanation: Connecting flight implica una conexión, no un vuelo sin escalas.

cards.statement: A direct flight does not require changing planes.
cards.explanation: Direct flight no tiene una conexión entre dos aviones.

cards.statement: Travel is normally uncountable when it means the activity in general.
cards.explanation: Decimos travel can be expensive, no normalmente a travel.

cards.statement: Baggage allowance is the place where you wait for a train.
cards.explanation: Baggage allowance es la cantidad permitida; el lugar del tren es the platform.

cards.statement: A single ticket includes both the outward and return journeys.
cards.explanation: A single ticket es solo de ida; a return ticket incluye la vuelta.

cards.statement: You collect your luggage before you land.
cards.explanation: Normalmente recoges el equipaje after landing.

cards.statement: A tour is usually an organised visit around places of interest.
We arrived in the station at eight.
cards.explanation: Se dice arrive at the station; arrive in se usa con ciudades o países.

cards.statement: A journey can be one part of a larger trip.
cards.explanation: Trip es la experiencia; journey puede ser cada trayecto.
